scope: Persist audio subtitles as local TXT records and expose them from settings and the subtitle bar
behavior: Every audio session accumulates original/translated segments with elapsed timestamps.
The TXT is auto-saved about 900 ms after updates and finalized when audio stops.
Header includes start time, source, recognition language (auto shows detected language), target language and model.
Settings → Audio subtitles has an “open records folder” button; the audio subtitle bar has a file button that opens the latest record.

notes: The first cross-language segment may retain only the original if a newer chunk aborts its pending translation; this is intentional so no speech is lost.
All records stay local; deleting the audio-records folder removes them.
